part.text:
Fixed. `Labels.DropMetricName` in model/labels/labels.go:352 was mutating the underlying label slice in place via `append(ls[:i], ls[i+1:]...)`. In range queries, the input series' labels are shared across all evaluation steps, so the first in-place drop corrupted the source labels (turning `__name__` into a duplicate `job` label), producing a second, corrupted series. The fix uses the three-index slice `ls[:i:i]` to zero out spare capacity, forcing `append` to allocate a new slice instead of writing into the shared array.

Verified: `TestRangeQuery` (including the `drop-metric-name` case), `./model/labels/...`, and the full `./promql/...` test suites all pass. The `stringlabels` and `dedupelabels` build variants were already safe since they build a new string rather than shifting a slice.
